training_scope: full fine-tuning (train_vlm): vision encoder, connector, language model and all 16 action expert layers; LeRobot still freezes the last VLM layer, its final norm and lm_head, which get no gradient
schedule_source: experiment 2's schedule = LeRobot SmolVLA defaults (lr 1e-4 for all trained parameters, betas 0.9/0.95, weight decay 1e-10, clip 10, warmup 1000, cosine to 2.5e-6), 15000 steps from the official smolvla_base; effective batch 64 = 16 x 4 accumulation on an RTX 4090 24 GB
data_scope: experiment 4: same data, split and sampling as experiment 3 (so101_pilot_v3: v2 demos + correction round 1, human-driven frames only, correction rows listed 4 times, static tails trimmed); normalization stats reused from runs/so101_pilot_v2/stats.json so offline validation stays comparable with experiments 2 and 3; top camera cache in /dev/shm (server disk is 50 GB), wrist cache in output
